changelog:
v2.2.0 — Audio System Overhaul

• DefaultTrackSelector with English audio preference (proper ExoPlayer integration)
• Label-based English fallback for streams with missing language metadata
• Audio status indicator — shows when stream has no audio or unsupported codec
• Audio-specific error handling for codec failures
• Preview player audio focus + English preference
• Audio diagnostic logging (debug builds only)
• Subtitles disabled by default (enable via track picker)
